ExampleSentence: La adolescencia es una etapa de muchos cambios.
ExampleTranslation: Adolescence is a stage of many changes.

ExampleSentence: La alegría se notaba en su cara.
ExampleTranslation: The happiness was visible on her face.

ExampleSentence: La amistad entre ellos dura más de veinte años.
ExampleTranslation: Their friendship has lasted more than twenty years.

ExampleSentence: El amor de una madre es incondicional.
ExampleTranslation: A mother's love is unconditional.

ExampleSentence: Mis padres celebran su aniversario de bodas hoy.
ExampleTranslation: My parents are celebrating their wedding anniversary today.

ExampleSentence: Le dio un beso en la mejilla.
ExampleTranslation: She gave him a kiss on the cheek.

ExampleSentence: La boda será en junio.
ExampleTranslation: The wedding will be in June.
Notes: Boda = the ceremony/event. "Matrimonio" = the institution of marriage.

ExampleSentence: Abrimos una botella de vino para brindar.
ExampleTranslation: We opened a bottle of wine to toast.

ExampleSentence: Vamos a brindar por los novios.
ExampleTranslation: Let's toast to the bride and groom.
Notes: Brindar por = to toast to. "El brindis" = the toast.

ExampleSentence: Quiero cambiar de trabajo el próximo año.
ExampleTranslation: I want to change jobs next year.
Notes: Cambiar de = to change (switch). "Cambiar" alone = to change/alter.

ExampleSentence: Mi hermana está casada desde hace cinco años.
ExampleTranslation: My sister has been married for five years.
Notes: Estar casado/a con = to be married to.

ExampleSentence: Mi mejor amiga se casa en diciembre.
ExampleTranslation: My best friend is getting married in December.

ExampleSentence: Celebramos su cumpleaños con una fiesta sorpresa.
ExampleTranslation: We celebrated his birthday with a surprise party.

ExampleSentence: Abrimos una botella de champán a medianoche.
ExampleTranslation: We opened a bottle of champagne at midnight.

ExampleSentence: Se comprometieron después de tres años juntos.
ExampleTranslation: They got engaged after three years together.

ExampleSentence: ¿Quieres ir conmigo al cine?
ExampleTranslation: Do you want to go to the movies with me?
Notes: Special form of "con + mí." Never "con mí."

ExampleSentence: Me encanta pasar tiempo contigo.
ExampleTranslation: I love spending time with you.
Notes: Special form of "con + ti." Never "con ti."

ExampleSentence: ¡Feliz cumpleaños! ¿Cuántos años cumples?
ExampleTranslation: Happy birthday! How old are you turning?
Notes: Same form singular and plural: el/los cumpleaños.

ExampleSentence: El 25 de diciembre es un día de fiesta.
ExampleTranslation: December 25th is a holiday.

ExampleSentence: Nos divertimos mucho en la fiesta.
ExampleTranslation: We had a lot of fun at the party.

ExampleSentence: Mis padres están divorciados desde que yo tenía diez años.
ExampleTranslation: My parents have been divorced since I was ten.

ExampleSentence: Se divorciaron después de quince años de matrimonio.
ExampleTranslation: They got divorced after fifteen years of marriage.

ExampleSentence: El divorcio fue muy difícil para la familia.
ExampleTranslation: The divorce was very difficult for the family.

ExampleSentence: A los niños les encantan los dulces.
ExampleTranslation: Kids love candy.

ExampleSentence: ¿Cuál es tu edad?
ExampleTranslation: What is your age?
Notes: A la edad de = at the age of.

ExampleSentence: Se enamoró de ella a primera vista.
ExampleTranslation: He fell in love with her at first sight.

ExampleSentence: El mensajero entregó el paquete esta mañana.
ExampleTranslation: The messenger delivered the package this morning.

ExampleSentence: Te voy a enviar las fotos por correo.
ExampleTranslation: I'll send you the photos by email.
Notes: Accent on í in some forms: envío, envías, envía.

ExampleSentence: Cuando eras niño, ¿qué querías ser?
ExampleTranslation: When you were a child, what did you want to be?

ExampleSentence: ¿Cuál es su estado civil?
ExampleTranslation: What is your marital status?
Notes: Options: soltero, casado, divorciado, viudo, separado.

ExampleSentence: La niñez es una de las etapas de la vida.
ExampleTranslation: Childhood is one of the stages of life.

ExampleSentence: Vamos a hacer una fiesta el sábado.
ExampleTranslation: We're going to have a party on Saturday.

ExampleSentence: De postre quiero un flan de caramelo.
ExampleTranslation: For dessert I want a caramel custard.
Notes: Classic Spanish and Latin American dessert.

ExampleSentence: Le regaló un ramo de flores por su aniversario.
ExampleTranslation: He gave her a bouquet of flowers for their anniversary.

ExampleSentence: ¿Quieres una galleta con tu café?
ExampleTranslation: Do you want a cookie with your coffee?

ExampleSentence: Decoramos la sala con globos de colores.
ExampleTranslation: We decorated the room with colorful balloons.

ExampleSentence: Me gradué de la universidad en mayo.
ExampleTranslation: I graduated from college in May.
Notes: Reflexive. Accent: me gradúo, te gradúas.

ExampleSentence: ¿De qué sabor quieres el helado?
ExampleTranslation: What flavor ice cream do you want?

ExampleSentence: Llegaron más de cien invitados a la boda.
ExampleTranslation: More than a hundred guests arrived at the wedding.

ExampleSentence: Te quiero invitar a mi fiesta de cumpleaños.
ExampleTranslation: I want to invite you to my birthday party.
Notes: Also: "invitar" can mean to treat (pay for someone).

ExampleSentence: Mi padre se jubiló a los sesenta y cinco años.
ExampleTranslation: My father retired at sixty-five.

ExampleSentence: Los niños jugaron al juego de las sillas en la fiesta.
ExampleTranslation: The kids played musical chairs at the party.

ExampleSentence: Pasamos mucho tiempo juntos.
ExampleTranslation: We spend a lot of time together.
Notes: Agrees in gender/number when used as adjective.

ExampleSentence: En su juventud, viajó por toda Europa.
ExampleTranslation: In his youth, he traveled all over Europe.
Notes: Stage of life between adolescence and adulthood.

ExampleSentence: Me llevo bien con todos mis compañeros.
ExampleTranslation: I get along well with all my coworkers.
Notes: Reflexive. "Llevarse bien/mal con" = to get along well/badly with.

ExampleSentence: Con la madurez llega la sabiduría.
ExampleTranslation: With maturity comes wisdom.

ExampleSentence: El matrimonio es un compromiso serio.
ExampleTranslation: Marriage is a serious commitment.
Notes: Also refers to a married couple.

ExampleSentence: El mensajero llegó con un paquete.
ExampleTranslation: The messenger arrived with a package.

ExampleSentence: La muerte de su abuela le afectó mucho.
ExampleTranslation: His grandmother's death affected him deeply.

ExampleSentence: Mi hijo nació en septiembre.
ExampleTranslation: My son was born in September.

ExampleSentence: Celebraron el nacimiento del bebé.
ExampleTranslation: They celebrated the baby's birth.

ExampleSentence: ¿Qué haces en Navidad?
ExampleTranslation: What do you do at Christmas?

ExampleSentence: Tuvo una niñez muy feliz.
ExampleTranslation: She had a very happy childhood.

ExampleSentence: Odio levantarme temprano los lunes.
ExampleTranslation: I hate getting up early on Mondays.
Notes: Regular -ar verb. Strong word — "no me gusta" is milder.

ExampleSentence: Hacen muy buena pareja.
ExampleTranslation: They make a very good couple.
Notes: Can refer to one's partner or to a couple together.

ExampleSentence: Lo pasamos muy bien en la playa.
ExampleTranslation: We had a great time at the beach.
Notes: Lo is invariable. "Pasarla bien" in Latin America.

ExampleSentence: Mi mamá hizo un pastel de chocolate para mi cumpleaños.
ExampleTranslation: My mom made a chocolate cake for my birthday.
Notes: Also: "la torta" or "la tarta" depending on region.

ExampleSentence: El pedido llegó incompleto.
ExampleTranslation: The order arrived incomplete.

ExampleSentence: Pedimos unos pinchos de tortilla en el bar.
ExampleTranslation: We ordered some tortilla pinchos at the bar.
Notes: Similar to "la tapa." Common in northern Spain.

ExampleSentence: ¿Qué hay de postre?
ExampleTranslation: What's for dessert?

ExampleSentence: La quinceañera bailó el vals con su padre.
English: young woman celebrating her fifteenth birthday
ExampleTranslation: The quinceañera danced the waltz with her father.
Notes: Important tradition in Latin America marking a girl's 15th birthday.

ExampleSentence: Los recién casados se fueron de luna de miel.
ExampleTranslation: The newlyweds went on their honeymoon.

ExampleSentence: Le regalé un libro a mi padre.
ExampleTranslation: I gave my father a book as a gift.

ExampleSentence: Nos reímos mucho con esa película.
ExampleTranslation: We laughed a lot during that movie.
Notes: Reflexive, stem-changing e→i. Accent: me río, te ríes.

ExampleSentence: Los fines de semana me gusta relajarme.
ExampleTranslation: On weekends I like to relax.

ExampleSentence: Ana rompió con su novio la semana pasada.
ExampleTranslation: Ana broke up with her boyfriend last week.
Notes: Romper con = to break up with. "Romper" alone = to break.

ExampleSentence: Mi hermana sale con alguien nuevo.
ExampleTranslation: My sister is dating someone new.
Notes: Irregular: yo salgo. "Salir con" = to date.

ExampleSentence: Están separados pero no divorciados.
ExampleTranslation: They are separated but not divorced.

ExampleSentence: Se separaron después de muchos problemas.
ExampleTranslation: They separated after many problems.

ExampleSentence: Sólo quiero descansar.
ExampleTranslation: I just want to rest.

ExampleSentence: Mi prima sigue soltera.
ExampleTranslation: My cousin is still single.
Notes: La despedida de soltero/a = bachelor/bachelorette party.

ExampleSentence: Ella siempre sonríe cuando me ve.
ExampleTranslation: She always smiles when she sees me.
Notes: Stem-changing e→i. Conjugated like "reír": sonrío, sonríes.

ExampleSentence: La fiesta me sorprendió mucho.
ExampleTranslation: The party really surprised me.

ExampleSentence: Le preparamos una sorpresa para su cumpleaños.
ExampleTranslation: We prepared a surprise for his birthday.

ExampleSentence: Tengo una cita con el dentista mañana.
English: to have a date; to have an appointment
ExampleTranslation: I have an appointment with the dentist tomorrow.
Notes: La cita = date/appointment. Context determines meaning.

ExampleSentence: Me tropecé con un viejo amigo en el centro.
ExampleTranslation: I ran into an old friend downtown.
Notes: Reflexive. Spelling change: tropecé. Also means to trip/stumble physically.

ExampleSentence: En la vejez es importante mantenerse activo.
ExampleTranslation: In old age it's important to stay active.

ExampleSentence: Mi abuela quedó viuda hace dos años.
ExampleTranslation: My grandmother was widowed two years ago.
